snapshot.eventDescription: The latest long/short reading for one coin on one exchange: all-account and top-trader ratios with long %, taker buy/sell, and open interest and liquidations where the exchange publishes them. The first row of every run is free.

history_point.eventDescription: One past reading for one coin on one exchange (history mode). The first row of every run is free.
